mapper.sql: o.status = 'SHIPPED' AND ((o.ship_time >= #{shipFrom} AND o.ship_time < #{shipTo}) OR (o.ship_time IS NULL AND o.order_time >= #{shipFrom} AND o.order_time < #{shipTo}))
mapper.select: SELECT o.id FROM ecom_order o LEFT JOIN ecom_review_request rr ON rr.order_id = o.id WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} AND AND (rr.id IS NULL OR rr.status = 'FAILED') ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit}
